data.gender_notes: Florentinus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'flos' meaning 'flower' and 'nus' meaning 'new'. The name Florentinus evokes images of growth, renewal, and prosperity. In Christian tradition, the name is associated with Saint Florentius, a fourth-century bishop known for his faith and miracles. The name Florentinus carries the meaning “Golden, flourishing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Florentinus usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, flourishing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Φλωρεντίνος

in_latin.name: Florentinus
